work: Created Wheel of Liverpool as a fixed, separately ticketed observation ride after official Park and StandaloneAttraction searches found no match. Integrated eight editorial descriptions, its own daily opening hours and wheelchair access condition, imported two exact licensed photographs, verified eight public pages and image delivery, and published the Facebook announcement.
